claims.text: The anchor no-show clause fails outright at limb (d). POL-NS-01 requires the trip to be terminated BY THE DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record shows the opposite: cancelled_by 'SYSTEM', cancellation_reason_code 'SYSTEM_TIMEOUT', status 'CANCELLED_BY_SYSTEM'. The driver did not terminate this trip on any recognised no-show code — he told the rider to cancel and then drove off, and the platform's clock closed the booking for him. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are conjunctive, so the SGD 4.00 fee is not chargeable and the rider must not carry it.

Limb (c) also fails on pure arithmetic, measured the way the clause insists — from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. The driver's own trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 40 seconds (21:46:50 to 21:47:30, 5 fixes at 10 s cadence) against a minimum dwell of 300 seconds for the LARGE_VENUE pickup zone class: a shortfall of 260 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages.

The one route that could stretch that 40 second run into a qualifying dwell — POL-NS-06(i), which sums separate in-geofence intervals — is unavailable on this record. The traffic advisory artefact is MISSING: EV-ADVIS-00601-01 has no payload and a weight_multiplier of 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). No KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory covers the pickup road in this window, so holding position was lawfully possible and there is nothing to accumulate. The single 40 second run is the whole of the driver's dwell.

Independently of the dwell question, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider on all three limbs. (a) At 21:47:50, inside the waiting window, the rider sent a locating message: 'I'm at the Bayfront pickup, is the black Vios you? you are driving off!' — she states her own position and asks after the driver. (b) The driver posted no reply at any point within 120 seconds of that message, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so there was no in-app voice call either. (c) The rider's device sat within the LARGE_VENUE presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes — in fact every one of them (41 of 41). The fee is therefore refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable.

The driver's account that 'the passenger was not at the pin' is contradicted by the rider's own telemetry. The rider track runs from 21:46:40 to 21:52:40, 41 fixes, with a minimum distance of 11.2 m, a mean of 15.7 m and a maximum of 19.5 m from the pin — comfortably inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, and the rider's distinct speed is a flat 0.0 kph, so she was stationary and waiting throughout. The rider did everything the platform asks of a waiting passenger; it was the vehicle that left.

No driver compensation is payable on these facts. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the cancellation fee only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'; limb (c) and limb (d) both fail here and POL-NS-06 displaces the charge in any event. The 20 percent platform residual and the driver's 80 percent share therefore both fall away, and the entire SGD 4.00 returns to the rider.

The money is real and it is the rider's. fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED, cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — the rider is presently carrying the disputed SGD 4.00. A FULL_REFUND under POL-GEN-03 returns the whole contested amount to the filing party, and the amount is exact: SGD 4.00 reconciles with the fee_schedule resolution rule as the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00). The refund to be ordered is SGD 4.00.

claims.text: The driver arrived, and the arrival marker is not false. His device telemetry carries 5 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, running from 21:46:50 to 21:47:30, with a minimum distance to the pin of 9.27 m, and the trip record's 'arrived' event at 21:46:55 falls inside that run. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the arrival timestamp the driver was stationary within the radius, not more than 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h or above. Whatever else is said about this trip, there was a real arrival at the pickup point.

Because qualifying in-geofence fixes exist, POL-NS-05(ii) cannot fire and there is no basis to record this trip as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list. The rider's suggestion of a phantom or dishonest arrival is contradicted by the driver's own trace, which is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 72 fixes at 10 s cadence, 100% coverage and no sampling gap.

Two of the four POL-NS-01 conditions are carried on this record: limb (a) by the trip record's driver 'arrived' event at 21:46:55, and limb (b) by the GPS fixes that place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before that timestamp, the first qualifying in-geofence fix being at 21:46:50. The driver did appear at the pickup point and held position there.

The sum charged is not overstated, so no part of the contested SGD 4.00 is an arithmetic surplus: the pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone (zone-class fee SGD 4.00) in a RYDE_X vehicle (vehicle-tier fee SGD 4.00), the greater-of resolution rule produces SGD 4.00, and that is exactly the cancellation-fee line on the ledger. There is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect for the rider to exploit.

The rider's 'known trick' theory of fee-farming is unsupported by the only counters the policy makes citable for it. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check withholds compensation only where no_show_terminations_30d is 4 or more AND that figure divided by completed_trips_30d exceeds 0.08; the driver's figures are 1 termination against 110 completed trips in the same 30-day window, a rate of about 0.009. The test does not trip, and no farming pattern may be inferred from a single timeout-ended trip.

The rider's own timeline is overstated, which bears on how closely her remaining assertions should be read: the record shows the booking requested at 21:40:00, the driver's 'arrived' event at 21:46:55 and the cancellation at 21:52:45 - about six minutes from request to arrival and twelve minutes from request to cancellation, not the 20 minutes she says she waited.

The driver does not stretch the two limbs that fail. The qualifying in-geofence dwell is 40 seconds against the 300-second minimum for a LARGE_VENUE pickup - a shortfall of 260 seconds - and the trip was ended by SYSTEM on cancellation_reason_code SYSTEM_TIMEOUT, which is not one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises and is not a driver-initiated termination at all. POL-NS-01 is therefore not satisfied in full, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line falls to be refunded to the rider under POL-NS-06. For the same reason the driver seeks no compensation under POL-NS-07, whose precondition is full satisfaction of POL-NS-01.

The consequence is bounded and carries no finding of misconduct against the driver. POL-NS-06 returns the cancellation-fee line only, and nothing else in the bundle is refundable to the filing party; the trip ended through the platform's own automatic timeout rather than any act of the driver, and no artifact records a second booking or any fare taken by this driver from the two people who boarded. The refund is an arithmetic consequence of the waiting period, not a finding that the driver ran a trick.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver — this case is decided on arithmetic, and both advocates ended up agreeing on it.

The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee cannot stand. The no-show charge under POL-NS-01 requires all four conditions to hold together, and two of them fail on this record. First, the driver's in-geofence dwell is 40 seconds (the single continuous qualifying run, 21:46:50 to 21:47:30, measured from the first qualifying GPS fix as the clause requires), against the 300-second minimum for this LARGE_VENUE pickup — a shortfall of 260 seconds. The one route that could have summed separate intervals, POL-NS-06(i), is unavailable because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00601-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so nothing accumulates. Second, the trip was not terminated by the driver on a recognised no-show code: the record shows cancellation_reason_code SYSTEM_TIMEOUT, cancelled_by SYSTEM, status CANCELLED_BY_SYSTEM. POL-NS-01 limb (d) names RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE and EXCESSIVE_WAIT only, and this trip matches none of them. With POL-NS-01 unsatisfied, POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line in full, and no driver compensation is payable under POL-NS-07 because its precondition — full satisfaction of POL-NS-01 — is not met.

The driver's arrival itself is not in doubt, and I accept his advocate's points on that: the trace carries five consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 120 m radius, closest approach 9.27 m, and POL-NS-05 is not engaged, so the arrival marker is not false and no false-arrival referral arises under POL-NS-05(ii). I also accept that the charge is not overstated — the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee are both SGD 4.00, the greater-of rule produces SGD 4.00, and the ledger line matches, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect.

The rider is separately exonerated under POL-NS-04: she sent a locating message at 21:47:50 ('I'm at the Bayfront pickup, is the black Vios you? you are driving off!'), the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), and her device stayed 11.2 m to 19.5 m from the pin on 41 of 41 qualifying fixes, well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius. The driver's account that she was 'not at the pin' is contradicted by her own telemetry.

On the driver's 'known trick' concern: I make no finding of fee-farming. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check reads no_show_terminations_30d (1) against completed_trips_30d (110) — a rate of about 0.009 — and does not trip, and neither does any POL-NS-09 limb. Nothing in this category's policy produces a referral on these facts, so the referrals list is empty. What the record does show — a driver who left the pickup with two other passengers while a booked rider stood metres away — is a conduct question outside the money this ruling moves; I flag it as an open question for the human reviewer rather than as a referral, because no clause in the loaded policy directs one.

Order: the contested SGD 4.00 is refunded in full to the rider. Driver compensation: none. Confidence 0.95, the deciding facts all resting on artifacts at weight 1.0 (POL-GPS-00601, EV-TRIP-00601, EV-FARE-00601, EV-CHAT-00601).

ruling.explanation:
Rider, your SGD 4.00 no-show charge is refunded in full. Driver, no compensation is payable.

THE FEE CANNOT STAND. To be chargeable under POL-NS-01 all four limbs must hold together. Limb (c) fails on arithmetic measured the way the clause insists — from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. The driver's own trace shows one continuous in-geofence run of 40 seconds (21:46:50 to 21:47:30, 5 fixes at 10 s cadence) against the 300-second minimum for a LARGE_VENUE pickup: a shortfall of 260 seconds. Limb (d) also fails: the trip record shows cancelled_by 'SYSTEM' and cancellation_reason_code 'SYSTEM_TIMEOUT', not a driver termination on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation-fee line is therefore refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages. The only route that could sum separate in-geofence intervals, POL-NS-06(i), is unavailable: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00601-01 is MISSING with no payload and weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so holding position was lawfully possible and the single 40-second run is the whole of the dwell. POL-NS-04 reaches the same result independently — the rider sent a locating message at 21:47:50 inside the waiting window, the driver never replied within 120 seconds and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, and the rider's device sat within the LARGE_VENUE 150 m presence radius for all 41 qualifying fixes.

NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; both preconditions fail here. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event (no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against completed_trips_30d = 110, a rate of about 0.009), so no escalation arises on that limb.

THE ARRIVAL ITSELF WAS GENUINE, AND THERE IS NO FALSE-ARRIVAL REFERRAL. The trace places the driver stationary inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at the arrival timestamp, with a minimum distance to the pin of 9.27 m, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged and POL-NS-05(ii) cannot fire: the trip is not recorded as a false-arrival event. The SGD 4.00 figure reconciles exactly with the fee_schedule resolution rule — the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) — and is precisely the ledger's cancellation-fee line, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect; the refund is the cancellation-fee line only.

Driver, your account that the passenger was not at the pin is not supported by the rider's telemetry, which places her within 19.5 m of the pin, stationary, for the whole wait. That the two other people boarded does not change the fee outcome, and no clause in this category produces a referral on that point; if the platform wishes to look at why the vehicle left a live booking, that is a question for its own channels, not a referral this ruling can order.

CONFIDENCE AND INTEGRITY. The deciding facts — the 40-second dwell and the SYSTEM_TIMEOUT termination — are carried by the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00601) and the trip record (EV-TRIP-00601), both at weight 1.0 and both independent of each other. Neither is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): no clock skew (arrived 21:46:55 sits within one 10 s fix of the trace), no sampling gap over 120 seconds, 72 fixes with 100 percent coverage, the chat holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, and the fee line reconciles. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor, so no escalation.

Both parties' accounts converge on the same arithmetic result, so this is decided on the record, not on credibility. Two of the four POL-NS-01 conditions must hold together for the SGD 4.00 no-show fee to be chargeable, and both fail.

Waiting period (limb (c)). The fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for at least 300 seconds (minimum_dwell_sec for a LARGE_VENUE pickup; the trip record gives pickup_zone_class LARGE_VENUE). The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00601, weight 1.0, 72 fixes at 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps) shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 40 seconds, from 21:46:50 to 21:47:30 — a shortfall of 260 seconds. The clause measures the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap, so the marker timestamp does not rescue it.

Termination (limb (d)). The clause requires the trip to have been ended by the driver on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00601, weight 1.0) shows cancelled_by SYSTEM, cancellation_reason_code SYSTEM_TIMEOUT, status CANCELLED_BY_SYSTEM. ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider.

The record. The booking was requested at 21:40:00, the driver's 'arrived' marker was set at 21:46:55, and the trip was closed by the platform at 21:52:45 on reason code SYSTEM_TIMEOUT (status CANCELLED_BY_SYSTEM). The pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone in a RYDE_X vehicle, so the minimum dwell is 300 seconds and the chargeable fee under the greater-of resolution rule is SGD 4.00 (zone-class fee 4.00 against vehicle-tier fee 4.00), exactly the cancellation-fee line on the ledger — the driver is right that there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect.

Why the fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 charges the fee only if all four limbs hold, and each limb must be met on its own terms. Limbs (a) and (b) do hold, and the driver's advocates are accepted on this: there was a genuine 'arrived' event at 21:46:55, and the trace places the driver inside the 120 m arrival radius from 21:46:50, so the claim of a real arrival at the pickup point is accepted and POL-NS-05 is not engaged — the marker was not false, there is no false-arrival record to make, and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral arises. The case turns on limb (c), which fails on arithmetic measured exactly as the clause directs, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap: the driver held the geofence for one continuous run of 40 seconds (21:46:50 to 21:47:30, 5 qualifying fixes), against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE — a shortfall of 260 seconds. Limb (d) fails too: the trip was terminated by SYSTEM on SYSTEM_TIMEOUT, not by the driver on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. With limb (c) and limb (d) both failing, POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line in full, whether or not the rider waited and whether or not she responded; POL-NS-04 independently reaches the same result (the rider's locating message at 21:47:50, no reply within 120 seconds and no in-app call on the trip record, and her device within the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius on 41 of 41 qualifying fixes).

Driver compensation. None is payable. POL-NS-07 pays the 80 percent share only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not; the driver's advocates correctly seek nothing. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event (1 no-show termination against 110 completed trips in 30 days, about 0.009 against the 0.08 rate threshold), so no POL-NS-09(d) escalation arises and no further review is directed. The fee is refunded, not held.

Weight and impairment. The only impaired artifact is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00601-01, which is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Its absence is citable and it is why POL-NS-06(i) cannot be used to accumulate separate in-geofence intervals: with no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory over the pickup road, the single 40-second run is the whole of the driver's dwell. The ruling itself rests on artifacts at full weight (the GPS trace and the trip record, both 1.0), so no confidence discount applies.

One credibility point, which does not change the outcome: the rider's account of a 20-minute wait is not borne out by the record, which shows about six minutes from request to the arrival marker and twelve minutes to cancellation. That discrepancy does not disturb the arithmetic above, which is what decides the case. Nothing in this ruling is a finding that the driver ran a trick; the refund follows from the waiting period alone.

ledger.claim: The anchor no-show clause fails outright at limb (d). POL-NS-01 requires the trip to be terminated BY THE DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record shows the opposite: cancelled_by 'SYSTEM', cancellation_reason_code 'SYSTEM_TIMEOUT', status 'CANCELLED_BY_SYSTEM'. The driver did not terminate this trip on any recognised no-show code — he told the rider to cancel and then drove off, and the platform's clock closed the booking for him. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are conjunctive, so the SGD 4.00 fee is not chargeable and the rider must not carry it.

Limb (c) also fails on pure arithmetic, measured the way the clause insists — from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. The driver's own trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 40 seconds (21:46:50 to 21:47:30, 5 fixes at 10 s cadence) against a minimum dwell of 300 seconds for the LARGE_VENUE pickup zone class: a shortfall of 260 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages.

The one route that could stretch that 40 second run into a qualifying dwell — POL-NS-06(i), which sums separate in-geofence intervals — is unavailable on this record. The traffic advisory artefact is MISSING: EV-ADVIS-00601-01 has no payload and a weight_multiplier of 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). No KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory covers the pickup road in this window, so holding position was lawfully possible and there is nothing to accumulate. The single 40 second run is the whole of the driver's dwell.

Independently of the dwell question, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider on all three limbs. (a) At 21:47:50, inside the waiting window, the rider sent a locating message: 'I'm at the Bayfront pickup, is the black Vios you? you are driving off!' — she states her own position and asks after the driver. (b) The driver posted no reply at any point within 120 seconds of that message, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so there was no in-app voice call either. (c) The rider's device sat within the LARGE_VENUE presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes — in fact every one of them (41 of 41). The fee is therefore refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable.

The driver's account that 'the passenger was not at the pin' is contradicted by the rider's own telemetry. The rider track runs from 21:46:40 to 21:52:40, 41 fixes, with a minimum distance of 11.2 m, a mean of 15.7 m and a maximum of 19.5 m from the pin — comfortably inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, and the rider's distinct speed is a flat 0.0 kph, so she was stationary and waiting throughout. The rider did everything the platform asks of a waiting passenger; it was the vehicle that left.

No driver compensation is payable on these facts. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the cancellation fee only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'; limb (c) and limb (d) both fail here and POL-NS-06 displaces the charge in any event. The 20 percent platform residual and the driver's 80 percent share therefore both fall away, and the entire SGD 4.00 returns to the rider.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the arrival timestamp the driver was stationary within the radius, not more than 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h or above. Whatever else is said about this trip, there was a real arrival at the pickup point.
